title: Multilingual Agent System for Inclusive Wildfire Evacuation Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2609.03301v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wildfire seasons have become 84 days longer in the current days than in the 1970s, causing enormous threats to one's financial status and short- and long-term health. During the fire, public agencies send out emergency messages to provide warnings and orders. Although 26 million people in the US have limited English proficiency, over 80% of those messages are only delivered in English, which can cause disproportionate information distribution and awareness. In order to better serve marginalized communities during emergencies, the authors developed BEACON, a service that provides comprehensive and personalized evacuation guidance, including navigation routes, personalized checklists, and a chatbot in the language that a user uses. Our current system ingests data including fire perimeter information, evacuation order status, and shelter information from Watch Duty. translated_title: 面向包容性野火疏散引导的多语言智能体系统
translated_abstract: 如今野火季节比20世纪70年代延长了84天，给人们的财务状况以及短期和长期健康带来了巨大威胁。火灾期间，公共机构会发布紧急信息以提供警告和指令。尽管美国有2600万人英语能力有限，但超过80%的此类信息仅以英语发布，这可能造成信息获取和灾害认知上的不平等。为了在紧急情况下更好地服务边缘化社区，作者开发了BEACON——一项提供全面且个性化疏散引导的服务，包括导航路线、个性化清单以及以用户所用语言进行交流的聊天机器人。当前的系统接入了来自Watch Duty的数据，包括火情周边信息、疏散指令状态和避难所信息。当用户处于距离火场一定范围内时，系统会利用……
tldr: 开发了多语言智能体系统BEACON，为英语能力有限的边缘化社区提供个性化的野火疏散引导服务，包括导航路线、个性化清单和母语聊天机器人，以弥合紧急信息传播中的语言不平等。
en_tdlr: BEACON, a multilingual agent system, provides inclusive and personalized wildfire evacuation guidance—including navigation routes, personalized checklists, and native-language chatbots—to serve communities with limited English proficiency.
